label: e/w input at position 3-5 in sequences starting with 3 or l
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (~0.03% of steps). It fires only in the original phase at positions 3-6, peaking at t=4 (59% of mass). It never fires at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or at t<3. It is a conjunction of current input e or w (90% of mass), first original token 3 or l (93% of mass), and prefix content: the previous token is most often y/u/k/j/e/t/w/n. The largest activations are e or w at t=4 after a letter. Rare weak firings happen on u, t, or c inputs and in sequences starting with i. first_tok in {3,l} plus input in {e,w} at t=3-6 covers 83% of the mass but has only about 22% precision. Adding the previous-token set and t<=5 raises dev F1 to 0.57, so the prefix dependence is only partly captured, like a lookup table.
